en: Psalms 116

zh: 為出死入生而讚美上帝

p.src: 1  I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

ja: と、あわれみを求める叫びを
en: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
u.src: 1  I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

en: 116:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

ja: けられた。 それゆえ、
en: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
u.src: 2  Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

p.src: 3  The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

ja: り囲み、 よみ の
en: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
u.src: 3  The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

ja: 116:3 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 116:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 4  Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

en: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
u.src: 4  Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

p.src: 5  The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

en: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.
u.src: 5  The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

p.src: 6  The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

en: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
u.src: 6  The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

p.src: 7  Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

ja: んでくださったからである。
en: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
u.src: 7  Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

p.src: 8  For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

en: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
u.src: 8  For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

p.src: 9  I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
u.src: 9  I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

p.src: 10  I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

ja: じた。それゆえ、こう言った。 「
en: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
u.src: 10  I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

p.src: 11  I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

en: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
u.src: 11  I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

p.src: 12  What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

ja: に与えてくださったすべての
en: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
u.src: 12  What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

p.src: 13  I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.
u.src: 13  I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

p.src: 14  I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

ja: への誓願を果たす。 主のすべての民の
en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
u.src: 14  I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

p.src: 15  Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

en: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
u.src: 15  Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

p.src: 16  LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

ja: はあなたのしもべである。
はあなたのしもべ、あなたの女のしもべの
en: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
u.src: 16  LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

p.src: 17  I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

en: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.
u.src: 17  I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

p.src: 18  I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people, 19  in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

ja: 私は主への誓願を果たする。 主のすべての民の前で、
で、 エルサレムよ、あなたのただ
zh: 我要在他眾民面前， 在耶和華殿的院內， 在耶路撒冷當中， 向耶和華還我的願。 你們要讚美耶和華！
en: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 18  I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people, 19  in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

ja: 116:19 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
en: 116:19 Hebrew: יה Yah
